title: Add Microsoft Graph API Support to SharePoint Connector
summary: The SharePoint Connector now supports Microsoft Graph API as an alternative to REST API, enabling downloads of files larger than 150 MB through chunked transfers while maintaining backward compatibility.
key_points: Added a toggle to choose between Graph API and legacy REST API implementations
New helper codeunits encapsulate Graph and REST operations separately
Graph API enables chunked downloads to bypass the 150 MB response size limit
Existing accounts default to REST API on upgrade to prevent breaking changes
Comprehensive test coverage for both API paths, account storage, and routing logic
quote: Graph API supports downloading files larger than 150 MB through chunked downloads
